## Detailed Tasks

### 1. Quote file mentions with spaces + normalize Windows separators

**What**: Add universal file-mention quoting and path normalization across all file-mention generation sites (suggest tool, diagnostics tool, agent-manager, bash tool error output).

**Why**: File mentions with spaces currently break or truncate at first space. Common on Windows ("Program Files", "Documents and Settings") and macOS ("Library/Application Support"). Cline #13402 demonstrates the fix: quote paths containing spaces, normalize Windows backslashes to forward slashes for cross-platform consistency.

**How**:
- Create `src/utils/file-mention.ts` with `maybeQuoteFilePath(path: string): string` helper (checks for spaces/special chars, wraps in quotes)
- Add `toPosixPath(path: string): string` for Windows backslash → forward slash normalization
- Audit and update file-mention generation sites:
  - `src/tool/tools/suggest.ts` (L1-46: suggestion file references)
  - `src/tool/tools/diagnostics.ts` (L1-200: file:line references in diagnostic output)
  - `src/core/agent-manager/orchestration-api.ts` (PR review comments with file paths)
  - `src/tool/tools/bash.ts` (L500-550: error message file paths)
- Add regression tests in `tests/tool/tools/` for paths with spaces + Windows backslash paths
- Test cross-platform: Windows paths work in Linux contexts and vice versa

**Done when**:
- [ ] `src/utils/file-mention.ts` exists with `maybeQuoteFilePath` and `toPosixPath` functions
- [ ] All four file-mention generation sites apply quoting + normalization
- [ ] Tests pass for paths with spaces: `"path with spaces/file.ts"`, `"C:\\Program Files\\test.ts"`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` pass

**Files to modify**:
- `src/utils/file-mention.ts` (new)
- `src/tool/tools/suggest.ts`
- `src/tool/tools/diagnostics.ts`
- `src/core/agent-manager/orchestration-api.ts`
- `src/tool/tools/bash.ts`
- `tests/tool/tools/file-mention.test.ts` (new)

**Size**: ~5h

### 2. PowerShell fail-fast error semantics

**What**: Set `$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'` in PowerShell -Command bootstrap scope so first non-terminating error terminates with non-zero exit and single error message.

**Why**: Current bash tool PowerShell wrapper does NOT set ErrorActionPreference. Malformed pipelines (e.g. `Get-ChildItem -Recurse | Where-Object { invalid syntax }`) emit thousands of stderr records and still exit 0. Cline #13358 adds fail-fast by setting ErrorActionPreference='Stop' in -Command bootstrap (GitHub Actions precedent).

**How**:
- Update `src/tool/tools/shell/id.ts` `shellSpawnArgs` function (L200-250: PowerShell branch)
- Modify PowerShell args from `['-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-Command']` to prepend ErrorActionPreference='Stop' in bootstrap scope (NOT string-prepend into user script so param(...) blocks stay in first-statement position)
- Add code comment documenting tradeoffs:
  - Partial-result commands (recursive listings over access-denied junctions) stop at first error instead of continuing
  - Windows PowerShell 5.1 in-script stderr redirection may become fatal
  - Per-command opt-out via `-ErrorAction Continue` or `-ErrorAction SilentlyContinue`
- Add regression tests in `tests/tool/tools/bash.test.ts`:
  - Malformed pipeline fails immediately with single error (not thousands of stderr lines)
  - Access-denied junction stops at first error
  - Document GitHub Actions precedent in test comments

**Done when**:
- [ ] `src/tool/tools/shell/id.ts` PowerShell branch sets `$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'`
- [ ] Code comment documents tradeoffs and opt-out pattern
- [ ] Malformed pipeline test passes (single error, non-zero exit)
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` pass

**Files to modify**:
- `src/tool/tools/shell/id.ts` (L200-250: shellSpawnArgs PowerShell branch)
- `tests/tool/tools/bash.test.ts` (add PowerShell fail-fast regression tests)

**Size**: ~4h

### 3. Durable todo agenda with scheduled tasks

**What**: Extend todowrite tool with scheduled-task creation/execution, tasks.json persistence, cron-style scheduler, workspace-scoped authority, approval flow.

**Why**: Current todowrite tool (src/tool/tools/todowrite.ts) is in-memory only, no persistence beyond session lifecycle, no scheduled execution. Cline #13331 adds durable agenda with scheduled tasks — agents can create follow-up tasks ("run tests after build", "daily npm audit"), automation reduces manual intervention.

**How**:
- Extend `src/tool/tools/todowrite.ts` schema to add optional `schedule` field (cron-style cadence: "in 5 minutes", "tomorrow at 9am", "daily at 9am")
- Create `src/core/task-scheduler.ts`:
  - `scheduleTask(task: ScheduledTask): void` - register task with scheduler
  - `runScheduler(): void` - background loop (checks every minute, executes due tasks)
  - `executeTask(task: ScheduledTask): Promise<void>` - dispatch via orchestrator
  - Persist tasks to `~/.alexi/tasks.json` (survives hub restart)
- Add workspace-scoped task authority:
  - Hub-level registration prevents cross-workspace task execution
  - Store workspace registration in tasks.json
- Add approval flow for task automation:
  - User must approve task automation before first execution
  - Reuse permission system from `src/permission/`
  - Broadcast failure cleanup (cancel on broadcast failure)
- Integrate scheduler with CLI:
  - Start scheduler in `src/cli/interactive.ts` (background thread or via background-process tool)
  - Stop scheduler on exit
- Add task execution commands guarded by workspace registration
- Add tests in `tests/tool/tools/todowrite.test.ts` for scheduled execution, approval flow, workspace isolation

**Done when**:
- [ ] `src/tool/tools/todowrite.ts` schema includes optional `schedule` field
- [ ] `src/core/task-scheduler.ts` exists with scheduleTask/runScheduler/executeTask functions
- [ ] Tasks persist to `~/.alexi/tasks.json` and survive process restart
- [ ] Workspace-scoped authority prevents cross-workspace execution
- [ ] Approval flow requires user consent before first execution
- [ ] CLI integration starts/stops scheduler
- [ ] Tests pass for scheduled execution, approval, workspace isolation
- [ ] Coverage >= 40% (CI requirement)
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm run test:coverage && npm run build` all pass

**Files to modify**:
- `src/tool/tools/todowrite.ts` (add schedule field to schema)
- `src/core/task-scheduler.ts` (new)
- `src/cli/interactive.ts` (integrate scheduler start/stop)
- `tests/tool/tools/todowrite.test.ts` (add scheduled task tests)
- `tests/core/task-scheduler.test.ts` (new)

**Size**: ~8h
